_note: Analytic pcurve goldens: expect is the RAW projection result (no window normalization applied). in_window is true iff the pcurve value at t=0 already lies in the canonical parameter window (U in [0,2pi) for periodic surfaces; V in [-pi/2,pi/2] for spheres, [0,2pi) for tori). normalized (sphere meridians only) replays the seam/pole canonicalization steps at reference t=0. Consistency invariant: surface(pcurve(t)) == curve(t). Planes also map an ellipse, parabola or hyperbola to the 2D curve with the frame mapped into the plane's (u, v), and a B-spline to the B-spline of its poles' plane coordinates (expect carries the 2D frame and radii/focal, or degree/poles/weights/knots/mults). curve_not_on_surface cases leave the plane; not_analytic cases sit on a curved surface (no closed form a Curve2D can hold). The 2D goldens were computed independently of the crate from the closed forms; consistency_points evaluate the 3D curve (Cox-de Boor for the B-splines).
